question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 19, 2024, for valuation of AIF investment portfolio, an independent valuer that is a partnership entity or company must be:

answer.text: A Registered Valuer Entity (RVE) registered with IBBI, with authorised person holding ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI/CFA membership

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD-1/P/CIR/2024/123 dated September 19, 2024: partnership/company valuer must be a Registered Valuer Entity registered with IBBI, with the deputed/authorised person holding ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI membership or CFA Charter. The Trap: An individual CA alone (without IBBI registration) is insufficient. Merchant banker/RBI are wrong regulators. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C and XIX-D both test this September 2024 amendment. XIX-E explicitly highlights this.
